parse_gemma4_args: parse a Gemma4 custom key:value argument string into a Python dictionary
parse_gemma4_value: parse a single Gemma4 value string into a Python object (bool, int, float, null, or string)
parse_gemma4_array: parse a Gemma4 array content string into a Python list of values
extract_tool_calls: extract tool calls from a Gemma4 model output string using regex matching
extract_tool_calls_streaming: extract streaming tool call deltas from partial Gemma4 model output text
